limitations: Full FFmpeg matrix used core candidate c040; final native a7cea354 rechecks build/j16. The optional workspace frontend and safeguards were added after the core matrix.
Tool binaries are matched musl/libc++ builds. External release recipes run under WSL Ubuntu with Clang18 and glibc, separately from the GNU-free Chimera gate.
Only fixed FFmpeg7.1.1 and Linux6.12 x86 defconfig configurations were measured; no claims about all packages or hardware.

Linux acceptance is incomplete. Two Clang18 runs and one isolated Clang19/64MB-stack run failed in the baseline with frontend exit139. Root cause is unresolved; the first exact Clang18 command replayed successfully outside omktr. Three measured pairs from the second run are exploratory only, below the required seven.

The separate Linux LLVM19 Docker image is sha256:42bae58178c98432973444c1b5b7de9b5e847f1fce7372c73a1034749902c050, Ubuntu24.04 Clang19.1.1 and Ninja1.11.1; it retains the same native baseline/candidate hashes and is not pooled with Clang18 timings.
CPU affinity uses 32 logical CPUs; filesystem caches remain warm, compiler caches disabled. No host CPU-frequency isolation.
Bootstrap intervals use seven paired samples and are workload evidence; independent rechecks retain earlier contrary observations.
The first manually linked workspace diagnostic binary4bd lacked matched linker options; its supplemental benchmark is excluded. Frozen core and final a7cea354 comparisons use matched options.
Compression observations are source-only. The final measurement may overlap validation jobs; its times describe cold costs and are not performance acceptance samples.
The first final FFmpeg recheck is excluded from acceptance because a filesystem lookup overlapped one sample. All rows are retained; the isolated repeat is used for acceptance.
The existing graph recursive counter only counts KATI_DEPTH markers; worker events and peak counts demonstrate opaque recursion and budget behavior instead.
Optional Portage results cover original EAPI8 fixtures, not arbitrary ebuilds or the optional real-package campaign.
